name: zmodel_const_quantize_and_normalize_uv_pairs
description: zModel_Const::QuantizeAndNormalizeUvPairs snaps polygon UVs to the recovered 1/256 grid and subtracts floored minima so the UV set is tile-relative.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the UV quantize and floor-normalize path. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x483510 validates the fastcall ABI with vertexCount in ecx and uvPairs in edx.

Binary Ninja assembly validates snapping each U/V component by truncating (coord - bias) * scale and multiplying by inverse scale, with recovered constants bias=-1/512, scale=256, and inverse scale=1/256.
Binary Ninja assembly validates finding snapped min U/V, flooring those minima, and subtracting the floored base from every pair.
The native smoke verifies quantization to 1/256 grid values and subtraction of floored U/V minima.
